annotations.title: Edit the Playground canvas in one batch

description: Apply one atomic, revision-checked, idempotent batch of non-paid canvas edits: create_node (text, image, video, video-stitch, comment, image-compare, output-gallery, video-frame-grab, list-node), update_node, connect, disconnect, group, ungroup, delete and tidy. Refer to nodes created earlier in the batch as "$name". Nodes without a position are placed in free space beside what feeds them. Connections use the same handle rules as the browser; image → video accepts role first_frame, last_frame or reference; image-compare takes two images, output-gallery collects images, and video-frame-grab takes one clip (framePosition first or last). A list-node takes items (text, one per run); connect it to an image node and that node runs once per item when generated (set batchCombineMode cross or zip on the image node for two lists). The batch commits as one reversible revision, or nothing changes. It never starts generation. Returns the mutation receipt, updated revision and created or changed canvas references.
